author: nc1234
content:
<@592004585506340885> Hey, I noticed some gossip validation vectors put an absolute `current_time_ms` on each message instead of the `offset_ms` documented here: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/e5f71d3a6e7cca40ae9b97364787a7297b1379a5/tests/formats/networking/gossip_validation.md?plain=1#L58
It started with #5294. Right now the ePBS and FOCIL topics (bid, envelope, payload attestation, proposer preferences, inclusion list) use only `current_time_ms`. Beacon block, attestation, aggregate and data column mix both in the same suite, e.g. gloas `gossip_beacon_block__ignore_parent_payload_not_verified` vs `gossip_beacon_block__ignore_future_slot`. 
We never noticed this switch in lodestar and our current runner silently set `offset_ms` to 0 whenever the field is absent
Was the switch intentional? If so, should the doc and the pre-gloas generators move to `current_time_ms` too?
